description: The movie screens. Movies are disc files ("XA/C1_20670"); a movie with a manifest key plays the file game.json names under that key when the disc has it. intro_fade_in: the save-card message fades in after wait_vblanks (60 per second), holds until a button is held or the frame counter passes hold_frames, fades out, then goes to next_state. intro: the intro movie (extra_movie while the extra option bit is set), then the fade step of the next screen (a fraction of the fade per frame) and next_state. intro_alternate: the intro started from a frame offset (the manifest key may give it; 0 there keeps frame_offset), then as intro. opening / exit_movie: the opening and the exit movies. debug_player (not used by the game): Left/Right count back from last_file, Enter plays, Cancel goes to cancel_state. silence_world_audio: movies for which the world's music and sound effects stop. Every key is checked: an unknown key is an error.
